description: This source file defines CLI commands and management logic for configuring environment variables of installed agent packages within the AgentField control plane. It includes functions for interactive setup, listing, setting, and unsetting environment variables, and handles package metadata and environment file operations.

classes.name: PackageConfigManager
classes.description: Handles environment variable configuration for installed agent packages, including loading metadata, reading/writing environment files, and interactive prompts.

methods.name: InteractiveConfig
methods.description: Runs an interactive session to configure environment variables for a specified package.

methods.name: ListConfig
methods.description: Lists current environment variable settings for a package.

methods.name: SetVariable
methods.description: Sets a specific environment variable for a package after validation.

methods.name: UnsetVariable
methods.description: Removes a specific environment variable from a package's configuration.

methods.name: loadPackageMetadata
methods.description: Loads package metadata and path from the registry and package files.

methods.name: loadEnvFile
methods.description: Reads environment variables from the package's .env file.

methods.name: saveEnvFile
methods.description: Writes environment variables to the package's .env file.

methods.name: promptForVariable
methods.description: Prompts user input for a single environment variable, handling secrets and validation.

methods.name: maskSecret
methods.description: Masks secret values for display purposes.
